name: Classical Gorgon
desc: A monstrous female entity from ancient Greek legend, featuring a mane of living venomous snakes, brass hands, tusks like a boar, and golden wings. Her gaze possesses the tragic power to turn any mortal who meets her eyes directly into solid stone.
weakness: Direct eye contact is required for her petrification. Opponents using polished, reflective surfaces (such as a bronze shield) can fight her safely without looking directly into her face. Blindness or fighting blindfolded completely negates her gaze attack.

actions.name: Petrifying Gaze
actions.desc: The gorgon turns her terrifying eyes upon a mortal within 60 feet. The target must roll {DEF} Endurance. On a failure, their flesh turns to heavy grey stone, restraining them. If they fail the Endurance a second time on their following turn, they are permanently transformed into a stone statue.

actions.name: Brass Claws
actions.desc: Rips into an enemy using her metallic hands, making a strike with {ATK} to rend flesh and splinter armor.

actions.name: Hissing Deflection
actions.desc: When targeted by a melee attack, the gorgon's snake hair rears back and strikes defensively, forcing the attacker to roll against {DEF} or take a penalty on their attack roll.
